definitions.explanation: The detailed points or particulars of a matter, as opposed to a general outline. A somewhat formal, written word, often appearing in business letters, newspaper advertisements, and fixed phrases like {委細|いさい}{面談|めんだん} (details to be discussed in person).

examples.japanese: {委細|いさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you about the details at a later date.

examples.japanese: {委細|いさい}⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧、⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will decide after discussing the details in person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{要項|ようこう}→要項：24071_youkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{委細|いさい}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ウェブサイト→ウェブサイト：05152_webusaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: For the full particulars of the application requirements, please see the website.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{委細|いさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記|き}した⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: The document setting out the particulars of the contract will be sent to you by next week.

notes:
Composed of {委|い} (entrust; detailed) + {細|さい} (thin, fine, detailed). A formal written word meaning "the fine details" or "full particulars" of a matter. In modern Japanese it lives mainly in set phrases used in business correspondence, job advertisements, and legal notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {委細|いさい}⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧: details to be discussed in person — a standard phrase in recruiting ads meaning "we'll give you the details when you come in"
- {委細|いさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧: details (will follow) at a later date
- {委細|いさい}⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧: understood in full detail — a somewhat old-fashioned phrase meaning "I fully understand the situation"
- {委細|いさい}{構|かま}わず: regardless of the details; without worrying about particulars
- {委細|いさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記|しる}す→記す：14238_shirusu⟧: to set out the details (in writing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧: details — by far the most common everyday word for "details." Use ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧ in almost all contexts; {委細|いさい} is reserved for formal or fixed-phrase use.
- {子細|しさい}: details; particulars — another literary word, largely interchangeable with {委細|いさい} in set phrases.
- ⟦{内訳|うちわけ}→内訳：10559_uchiwake⟧: breakdown — the itemized components of a total (e.g., of a bill or budget).

USAGE:
Because the word is formal and slightly old-fashioned, using it in casual speech sounds odd. It is best learned as part of the set phrases above, especially {委細|いさい}⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧, which you will see constantly in want ads. When you simply want to say "the details," use ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧.
